title.zh: 将甲米地市Dra. Olivia Salamanca医院床位由50张增至75张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, From Fifty (50) To Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, From Fifty (50) To Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, từ năm mươi lên bảy mươi lăm giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของ Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, จากห้าสิบเป็นเจ็ดสิบห้าเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, dari lima puluh menjadi tujuh puluh lima tempat tidur
title.ms: Akta menambah kapasiti katil daripada Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, daripada lima puluh kepada tujuh puluh lima katil

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7522_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Dra. Olivia Salamanca Hospital in Cavite City, is hereby increased from fifty (50) to seventy-five (75) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
